IC1: Untreated symptomatic brain [OR] or leptomeningeal metastatic disease.
IC2: Medical [OR] or psychiatric conditions comprising informed consent.
IC3: Any medical condition which in the opinion of the investigator would compromise the ability of the patient to participate in the trial or which would jeopardise compliance with the protocol.
IC4: Radiotherapy within 4 weeks of trial entry.
IC5: Active autoimmune disease [AND] that has required systemic treatment in past 2 years
IC6: Chronic usage of steroids [OR] or other immunosuppressant medication.
